mock.successResponse: Your agent is ready to try. I set its goal, chose the right abilities, and ran a first test. Everything looks good. Open Live to talk to it, or Structure to see how it works.
mock.warningResponse: Your agent is built, but the test found a small issue: one answer was a bit unclear. You can try it as is, or let me fix it.
mock.errorResponse: I couldn't finish this build. The test failed while checking answers. I can fix it for you, or you can rephrase your request with a bit more detail.
mock.repairResponse: All set. I adjusted the instructions and ran the test again. Your agent is ready to use.
mock.executionDisabled: Building is temporarily unavailable. Your message was saved. We'll continue as soon as the service is back.

identity.prompt: Before I build your agent, tell me how it should introduce itself.
identity.name: Agent name
identity.confirmedNext: Next step: connect a brain (LLM) with your API key so the agent can actually think.

ready.title: First version ready
ready.success: Your agent is ready to try. I wrote its instructions, unlocked abilities and memory, built the structure, and passed a quick test. Open Live to chat with it, or keep improving it here.
ready.llmKeyRequired: Add your LLM API key before testing Live.

modify.success: Done. I applied your change and updated the agent. Keep chatting here to refine it, or open Structure to inspect what changed.
modify.warning: I applied your changes, but the quick test found a small issue. We can fix it, or you can keep iterating here.

secrets.prompt:
For your agent to think, connect a brain (LLM) with your API key.

Pick a provider, paste your key, then save. It is encrypted and will never be shown in full again.
secrets.saved:
Saved.

Your key is in place.
secrets.secureNotice: Your key is encrypted and used only to power this agent.
secrets.byokHint: Paste your key. You can show or hide it while typing. We only keep a short masked hint.

capabilities.prompt:
Almost there. Tell me how this agent should work:

• remember this chat?
• keep long-term memory?
• use your documents?
• run on a schedule?

Toggle what you want below, add a note if useful, then build.
capabilities.promptAfterSecret:
Key saved — thank you.

Now, how should this agent work?

• remember this chat?
• keep long-term memory?
• use your documents?
• run on a schedule?

Toggle your choices below, then build the agent.
capabilities.saved:
Got it.

I'm building the first version with these settings. This can take a moment.
capabilities.memoryConversationHint: Keeps the conversation coherent as you talk.
capabilities.memorySemanticHint: Remembers important facts between sessions (you stay in control).
capabilities.knowledgeHint: Lets the agent search files you add later.
capabilities.scheduleHourlyHint: Prepares an automatic hourly run (coming soon). We already save it in the config.
capabilities.contextNotesPlaceholder: e.g. short answers, school level, tools to connect later…
capabilities.appsComingSoon: App connections (email, Slack, Drive) arrive next. Leave a note if you want them.
